sourceTexts.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֱלֹהִים לַיַּבָּשָׁה אֶרֶץ וּלְמִקְוֵה הַמַּיִם קָרָא יַמִּים וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים כִּי טוֹב

literalTranslations.pt: E chamou Deus à porção seca terra; e ao ajuntamento das águas chamou mares; e viu Deus que era bom.
literalTranslations.en: And God called the dry land earth; and the gathering together of the waters He called seas; and God saw that it was good.
